checks.bit_bin_pair: the .bin is not the .bit's payload: a .bin from another build; copy out/ again.
checks.bit_header_length: not a Xilinx .bit: use the .bit or .bin the build wrote in out/.
checks.board_static: the build is for another static than the board runs: fetch the board's kit, generate the script again and rebuild. A partial for another static can destroy the FPGA's configuration, and the static_id alone cannot see it.
checks.build: the build did not pass: fix the gate its receipt names, then run the build again.
checks.clearing: the clearing is not the file the build wrote (another build's, or half-copied): copy out/ from the build again, or rebuild.
checks.clearing_fits: the clearing is larger than the harness's arena: shrink the RM, or ask for a harness with a larger clr_max.
checks.clearing_pairs_partial: the clearing's frames are not inside the partial's: a clearing from another RM.
checks.device_global_writes: the stream writes IPROG, AXSS or WBSTAR, or passes to another SLR: a partial never does. It is a full image: use this build's partial.
checks.expected_static: the build is for another static than the one --static-id names (the receipt's static_id is the CRC-32 of the DCP the build opened): build again with `kit script --static-id ID`, or check it without the flag to see which static it is for.
checks.files: a kit file does not match its sha256 (corrupt or edited): fetch the kit again.
checks.frame_box: frames outside the partition: a partial for another partition or another floorplan.
checks.idcode: another device's bitstream, or a multi-SLR image: use this build's pair.
checks.kit: the kit of the build's static is not cached, so the partition's frames were not compared: fetch the kit, then check again.
checks.ltx: the .ltx is not the one the build wrote: copy out/ again; a stale .ltx names probes the partial does not have.
checks.part: a bitstream for another device: use this build's pair.
checks.partial: the partial is not the file the build wrote (another build's, or half-copied): copy out/ from the build again, or rebuild.
checks.partial_flag: a full image, not a partial: use the <name>_partial.bit the build wrote.
checks.rm_id: the netlist drives another rm_id than RM_ID (or 0, the greybox's): make the wrapper's localparam and the design's rm_id one value, then rebuild.
checks.rm_id_clash: the design id is another design's: Program and the CLCD would show that name. Take the rm_id HM proposes (add it to the design to keep it).
checks.rm_id_range: the design id is in the platform's range: user designs take 0x8000-0xFFFF. Take the rm_id HM proposes.
checks.role: the partial and the clearing are swapped (a partial issues START, a clearing AGHIGH): swap the two files.
checks.shell_id: the kit is for another static than the board runs: fetch the board's own kit.
checks.static_id: the receipt names no static: it was not written by build_rm.tcl, or was edited; rebuild.
checks.stream: the file is truncated or not a configuration stream: copy it again.
checks.usercode: the kit is for another implementation run of this static: fetch the kit again from the release that fielded the board.
checks.vivado: another Vivado ran the script. A kit needs the release that wrote its static (2024.1 refuses a 2026.1 DCP with [Runs 36-378]): run that one.
checks.vivado_path: the `vivado` on PATH is another release than the kit's (a login profile may put one first): run the full path `kit build` prints, or put the kit's release first on PATH (`export PATH=<its bin>:$PATH`).
checks.vocabulary: commands or registers the kit's own partials never use: not a partial of this partition.
checks.xdc: the design fails an XDC check: fix the port or group it names (the XDC section previews the same checks).
checks.xdc:static_id: HM's pin model describes another static, so it cannot write this kit's XDCs or check the wrapper: build for the static the model has (the XDC section names it).

gates.fix: another Vivado ran the script. A kit needs the release that wrote its static (2024.1 refuses a 2026.1 DCP with [Runs 36-378]): run that one.
the device family is not installed with this Vivado: add UltraScale (Kintex) with the Vivado installer.
the kit's DCP is not where the script looks: run `harness-manager kit script` again, or fetch the kit.
the DCP is not the kit's static (a wrong, stale or corrupt copy): `harness-manager kit fetch` again. Never rebuild the static.
RM_ID must be a 32-bit hex literal such as 0x01008000.
rm_id 0 is the greybox's: give the RM its own (HM proposes one).
a file in RM_SOURCES does not exist: fix the path in the design.
no RTL was named: set build.sources in the design, or RM_SOURCES.
the OOC XDC is missing: `harness-manager xdc rm-kit` writes it.
PR_VERIFY_REF names a file that does not exist: leave it empty (the locked static is the reference) or fix the path.
RM_SYNTH_DCP names a file that does not exist: fix the path, or leave it empty to synthesise from RM_SOURCES.
RM_XDC names a file that does not exist: fix the path in the design.
a module synthesised as a black box: a source file is missing from RM_SOURCES; the listed cells name the missing modules.
the wrapper's ports are not the partition's: start again from the kit's wrapper skeleton (xdc/<name>_wrapper_skeleton.sv).
rm_id is driven by logic: drive rm_id from one constant.
the netlist's rm_id differs from RM_ID: make the localparam and the design's rm_id one value (HM writes the manifest from the netlist's).
nothing was timed: read the kit's OOC XDC (xdc/<name>_ooc.xdc).
the partition instance is not in the static: the wrong kit for this script.
the partition's pin count changed at link: the wrong kit for this static, or a static-side debug core; tell the lab.
no clock reached the partition: the wrong kit, or a broken static.
HDPR-16: an ILA with no RM-side debug hub (add the dbgbscan group and an RM-side debug_bridge); HDPR-18/50: a BUFG, MMCM, BSCAN or pad inside the RM (generate no clocks in the RM).
opt_design changed the partition's pins: a static-side debug core punched hub ports into it; tell the lab.
a routed DRC error inside the partition: read <name>_drc.rpt.
negative slack in the RM's own paths, or an RM-internal async crossing left unconstrained: add an RM_XDC (read_xdc -cell). ALLOW_TIMING_FAIL=1 is for experiments only.
the static in the build is not the reference: fetch the kit again, and do not mix kits.
the .ltx was not written: rerun the bitstream stage.
a bitstream file is missing: rerun the bitstream stage.
the clearing is larger than the harness's arena: shrink the RM, or ask for a harness with a larger clr_max.
a Tcl or Vivado error outside any gate: read build_rm.log at the line before HM_RM_BUILD_FAILED.
